name: Ryuuzaki Kaoru
source:
Kaoru is very innocent and is well protected from danger by older idols. She is not a very good cook, but has fun trying her best. She holds her time with Producer (who she calls Sensei) very closely to her, and has even come back to school after she walked nearly all the way home just so the Producer could pick her up.

[From [url=http://www.project-imas.com/wiki/Kaoru_Ryuzaki]Project IM@S Wiki[/url]]
